<!-- forge-continuity-contract:v2 -->
<!-- GitHub concept: this PR is a bounded mutation proposal. CI may prove integration conditions; merge != deploy; deploy != runtime health. -->
<!-- Fill each section with evidence or explicit N/A + reason. Gate != future project. -->

## Mission / return-to
<!-- Canonical Objective/Epic/Issue and the exact cell this PR returns to. Why does this mutation exist? -->

## Existing canonical state
<!-- What already exists and is reused? Which older PR/branch/contract is superseded? -->

## Capability / accountable owner
<!-- BUILD / DESIGN / FLOW / STATE / etc. This is accountability for this mutation, not agent identity ownership. -->

## Mutation
<!-- Smallest bounded code/data/config/docs mutation in this PR. A PR is not the entire project plan. -->

## Authority / state ownership
<!-- Which source may mutate? Which store/runtime owns truth? What is projection-only? -->

## Test / evidence
<!-- Reproducible checks, receipts, runtime observations, CI, readback, screenshots only when evidentiary. -->
<!-- CI green means the tested conditions passed. It does NOT by itself prove deployment or runtime health. -->

## Failure / UNKNOWN / recovery
<!-- Failure modes, retry safety, compensation, rollback, blockers. UNKNOWN != FAILED. -->

## Continuation / release gate
<!-- On merge/PASS, what same mission cell advances next? On failure, what smallest cell reopens? -->
<!-- If deployment/release follows, name that separate CD/release gate. Merge alone is not promotion. -->
